review_type: Independent AI editorial support review; not human acceptance, clinical approval, a taste test or publication authority.

scope_description.population: All 218 technically reviewable snack| candidates, excluding the separately assigned overnight-oat recipes.
scope_description.method: Actual ingredient and quantity variants, methods, equipment, allergens, nutrient estimates and ingredient identities, storage and food-safety text were reviewed in the original snapshot. All unchanged fields were compared against the frozen input; all corrected method patterns and final serving metadata were re-read.
scope_description.serving_metadata: Servings, meal type, prep/cook/rest/total time, estimated-time wording, food format, tags and taxonomy inspected. No claim of cooking or product-label verification.
scope_description.nutrition: Ingredient identity, quantity, plausible recipe-level estimates and declared canonical-proxy limitations reviewed. Does not claim laboratory validation; the separate full Decimal audit supplies arithmetic evidence.

resolved_findings.finding: Final assembly came after the instruction to eat.
resolved_findings.resolution: All final flavour, yoghurt and chocolate steps now precede eating or refrigeration.

resolved_findings.finding: Bean-dip methods did not explicitly use the measured lemon juice.
resolved_findings.resolution: The listed lemon juice is explicitly mixed with ready-cooked canned chickpeas and the measured savoury add-on.

resolved_findings.finding: No-cook tuna pots did not state the required sweetcorn preparation.
resolved_findings.resolution: The method explicitly requires canned ready-to-eat sweetcorn, drained before weighing and kept chilled.

resolved_findings.finding: Coffee and cherry variants benefited from more explicit preparation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Coffee methods specify measured water and cooling; cherry methods specify removal of stones and edible-fruit weight.

limitations: Food-safety review checks the authored instructions for internal completeness; it is not clinical or professional certification.
The candidate retains draft status and its second-person human acceptance gate.

Equipment none is interpreted as no specialist cooking appliance, as in the existing snack taxonomy; ordinary utensils and a source of boiled water for the coffee variants remain described in the methods.
Taxonomy protein_focus and main_protein are inherited grouping hints rather than independently verified nutrition claims; displayed numeric nutrient estimates were reviewed.
